You may submit questions in any of the following ways:
  - On our [community forum](https://community.acme.com/c/acme-logstore/41)
  - To our [mailing list](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/logstoreproject)
  - In `#logstore` in [Acme's Public Slack](https://slack.acme.com/)

**NOTE: All questions submitted as issues will be closed.**
